report:
# events-fall — dated events Sep 28 – Dec 31, 2026

**Totals:** 97 events and 30 series records as researched; 100 events and 30 series after verification (see the Verification section at the end). All pages were read on 2026-09-27 (Sunday).

**By kind:** market 24, holiday 15, festival 13, family 11, food-drink 9, cultural 7, parade 7, exhibition 4, concert 3, fair 2, film 1, fireworks 1.
**By region (sheet):** tampa 28, clearwater 24, stpete 20, around 9, daytrips 8, beaches 8.
**By start month:** 2026-09 1, 2026-10 49, 2026-11 28, 2026-12 14, started before Sep 28 5.

## What is covered
Festivals (Clearwater Jazz Holiday, Tampa Pig Jig, John's Pass Seafood Festival, Tarpon Springs Seafood Festival, Tampa Greek Festival, Oktoberfest Tampa, Piertoberfest, SHINE, SAVOR St. Pete, Sanding Ovations, Dunedin Wines the Blues, Dunedin Celtic Festival, Plant City Pig Jam, BayFest, Largo Vibe Fest, St. Pete Fall Festival, Armature Works Fall Fest, Florida Fin Fest, St. Pete Country Fest, Haunted Fest), theme-park seasons (Busch Gardens Howl-O-Scream and Christmas Town, LEGOLAND Brick or Treat and Christmas Bricktacular, Florida Aquarium Guppyween), Halloween (Halloween on Central, Riverwalk Trick-or-Treat, History Center Night at the Museum, Fall-O-Ween, Dunedin golf-cart parade and trick-or-treating, Safety Harbor Fright Nights, Water Street Whispers After Dark, pet and dog parades, pumpkin patches and farm festivals), holiday lights and tree lightings (Holiday Lights in the Gardens, Largo Central Park lights, Shimmering Lights, Santa Fest, Water Street Season Spectacular, Clearwater, Safety Harbor and Snow Place Like Tarpon Springs), boat parades (Tampa Riverwalk, Alafia, Clearwater), New Year's Eve (Clearwater Sunset to Sparkle), market series (Ybor, St. Pete Saturday Morning, Corey Ave, Hyde Park Fresh Market, Safety Harbor, Dunedin, Gulfport Tuesday and Night markets, Madeira Beach Wednesday, Water Street and Seminole Heights Sunday markets) as date + end_date + time_text (and occurrences for monthly ones), art and craft shows and holiday markets, community and cultural events (Tampa Theatre's 100th birthday on Oct 15 and the Plant Museum's Cigar City Cinema centennial exhibit, Fiesta SOMOS St. Pete, Hispanic Heritage Month at the Dalí, Navratri and India Festival at the fairgrounds, Plant City Pioneer Day, Veterans Day ceremonies in Largo and Safety Harbor), two Dalí exhibitions, the Hillsborough County Fair, and day-trip events (Sarasota Medieval Fair, Siesta Key Crystal Classic, St. Armands and Sarasota fall art festivals, Hunsader Farms Pumpkin Festival).

Series: 30 records for the recurring signature events; 20 reuse the ids the events-spring slice already wrote for the annual calendar (howl-o-scream, christmas-town-busch-gardens, clearwater-jazz-holiday, santa-fest-tampa, winter-village-tampa, …) so the merge unites them. Series without a 2026 date on the organizer's page are recorded as series only, with the last published date in when_text: winter-village-tampa, florida-aquarium-yuletides, tarpon-springs-christmas-parade, tarpon-springs-illuminated-boat-parade.

## How candidates were found
WebSearch was unavailable to this agent (the session's search budget was already used) and Bing, DuckDuckGo, Qwant and Brave returned bot pages, so discovery used lists read directly:
- Visit Tampa Bay: its sitemap.xml lists 388 /tampa-events/details/ pages; the festival, holiday, market and community listings that looked visitor-scale were read (concerts, games, classes, walks and bar crawls were left to other slices or skipped). The /tampa-events/september/ round-up was read; October to December round-ups do not exist yet (404).
- Visit St. Pete-Clearwater: /events, /events-festivals, /fall, /winter pages and event listings (Saturday Morning Market, Corey Ave Sunday Market, Holiday Lights in the Gardens, Clearwater Jazz Holiday).
- The Events Calendar REST feeds (wp-json/tribe/events/v1) of the St. Pete Pier, I Love the Burg (329 St. Pete-area events), Hyde Park Village, Tampa Bay History Center, the Dalí, Tampa Museum of Art, Sunken Gardens, the St. Pete Arts Alliance, the Florida State Fairgrounds, the Anna Maria Island Chamber, Bok Tower Gardens, Carrollwood Cultural Center, MFA St. Pete and Pinellas County.
- City calendars: City of Tampa featured events and Santa Fest; Safety Harbor (special-events list, December month view and each event page); Tarpon Springs (Nov and Dec month views); Clearwater (Coachman Park and Clearwater Beach event pages); Dunedin (event directory URLs from its sitemap); Largo Recreation special events; Madeira Beach events; St. Pete Beach and Treasure Island calendars (nothing relevant posted).
- Organizer schedules: SIK Promotions (fall craft shows, Tarpon seafood festival, Early Elf, Gulfport night market), Paragon Festivals, Tampa Bay Markets, Tampa Riverwalk events, Water Street Tampa, Armature Works, LEGOLAND seasonal events, Busch Gardens, Florida Aquarium, Clearwater Yacht Club.
- Wikipedia's List of festivals in Florida (food festivals by month) and the events-spring slice's series list were used only as candidate lists; each record's facts come from its own source page.

## Deliberately left out, and why
- TIGLFF 2026 ran Sept 10-13 (St. Pete) and Sept 18-20 (Tampa): outside the window (tiglff.com).
- Guavaween: guavaween.com is a parked domain and the Ybor City Chamber calendar (Sep 28 - Dec 31) lists no Guavaween or Ybor Halloween parade. No record.
- St. Pete First Night: firstnightstpete.com is a parked lander page. No record.
- ZooTampa seasonal events: zootampa.org is behind a SiteGround captcha for both curl and WebFetch, and web.archive.org is blocked here. Nothing read, no record (a gap to fill).
- Tampa Theatre's own site is behind the same captcha; its 100th-birthday record rests on the Visit Tampa Bay listing.
- No 2026 date published yet: Winter Village (site shows the 2025 season), Florida Aquarium YuleTides, Tarpon Springs Christmas parade and Illuminated Boat Parade, Riverwalk Tree Lighting and Riverwalk New Year's Eve (2025 pages), Tampa Bay Caribbean Carnival (no dates on its page), Armature Works pumpkin patch (2024 hours on its page), LEGOLAND Kids' New Year's Eve (page says 'December 31' without a year): series or nothing.
- Not found on any readable official page: St. Petersburg and Dunedin lighted boat parades, holiday parades in St. Pete, Dunedin and Plant City, Veterans Day parades in Tampa and St. Pete, New Year's Eve fireworks in Tampa and St. Pete, Día de los Muertos events, Dunedin Art Harvest (the Junior League site returned no content), Rattlesnake Festival (site error), Bradenton Blues Festival (parked domain), Ruskin Seafood Festival, Cotee River Seafood Festival.
- Out of window: Chalk the Bay (Jan 15-17, 2027), Tampa Fine Art Show (Feb 27-28, 2027), Hondo Rodeo Fest (Feb 26-28, 2027), Viva Tampa Bay (January): for events-spring.
- Other slices: concerts at arenas and amphitheaters (e.g. Nightmare on Channelside, Coachman Park concerts), games and bowls (Gasparilla Bowl, Lightning, Bucs), races (Hot Chocolate Run, St. Pete Run Fest). Three music festivals are kept here as festivals because they are multi-act weekend events (St. Pete Country Fest, Florida Fin Fest, Haunted Fest); events-shows may also hold them.
- Small neighborhood items (kids' markets, paint parties, bar crawls, brewery Oktoberfests, church trunk-or-treats, club fundraisers, garage sales) were skipped as not visitor-scale.

## Sources and caveats the verifier should check
- Records sourced from Visit Tampa Bay listings because the organizer page was unreadable or undated: Tampa Theatre 100th Birthday, Alafia Lighted Boat Parade, Vintage Market Days, Kingdoms of Lights, Jingle Bell Bazaar, Hispanic Heritage Month at the Dalí, Keel Farms Harvest Days, USF Fall Plant Festival, Tampa Bay Coffee & Art Festival (also on the fairgrounds calendar). Holiday Lights in the Gardens and the St. Pete Saturday Morning Market rest on Visit St. Pete-Clearwater listings.
- Conflicts noted in notes: Sanding Ovations encore weekend (home page Nov 28-29; schedule page Nov 27-29, used); Largo Holiday Lights end (list says 'Nightly thru Dec 27th' in one line, detail page Nov 26 - Jan 3, used); SHINE (festival page Nov 6-15, used; Arts Alliance feed Nov 8-17); Cigar City Cinema (header Feb 28, 2027; body text says 2026); Hyde Park Fresh Market (text 10am-2pm, feed 10-3); Gulfport Tuesday market (chamber page 9am-2pm; see-pinellas has 9-3 Oct-May); Madeira Beach Wednesday Market (15000 vs 15033 Madeira Way); Raprager Farms (VTB date field ends Oct 30, text says Nov 1).
- Coordinates that are approximate: Sarasota Medieval Fair (the fair's mailing address), Plant City Pig Jam (street match), BayFest (Pine Avenue street match), Halloween on Central (1600 Central Ave, mid-route), Largo Veterans Day (park address). Folly Farm (Safety Harbor), J.D. Hamel Park and the SHINE/ArtWalk districts have no coordinates.
- Inferences flagged in notes: Fiesta SOMOS St. Pete's latin-heritage topic (from the name only); the Dalí Hispanic Heritage program's link to its Oct 1 film and Oct 15 Latin jazz nights (by title and date).
- Admission is null wherever the page did not state it (Pig Jig, John's Pass, Oktoberfest, Country Fest, Greek Festival, many markets); is_free is true only where the page says free.
- Events that start before Sep 28 but run into the window keep their real start date: Howl-O-Scream (Sept 11), Hispanic Heritage Month at the Dalí (Sept 15), Raprager Farms (Sept 18), LEGOLAND Brick or Treat (Sept 19), Dalí in America (May 9).

## Verification (2026-09-27)

An adversarial verifier re-read every record's source on Sep 27, 2026: 97 events and 30 series (127 records). Pages were read with curl (text extracted locally) and, where curl was blocked (buschgardens.com, visitstpeteclearwater.com, myclearwater.com, dunedin.gov, a few city calendar entries), with WebFetch. Every description and quote was string-matched against its page; all are verbatim (the few misses were extraction artifacts such as "100 th" or a space before a comma). WebSearch was unavailable (the session's search budget was spent), so completeness work used official listings and event feeds.

**Fixed (31 events with substantive changes; every record got a dated "Verifier:" note and checked = 2026-09-27):**
- Hours that were on the page but missing or wrong: Largo Vibe Fest (per-day hours 3-8 / 10-5 / 10-3 were published); Piertoberfest (the Pier's signature page says 12-10 PM, not 11); Clearwater Jazz Holiday (each day's end = the last listed set); Tampa's Santa Fest (the 2026 schedule is published: parade 1 p.m., tree lighting 6 p.m., movie 6:45); Vintage Market Days (Sunday is 11-3, not 10-4; now sourced to the organizer, title as the organizer prints it); Cigar City Cinema and Dunedin Downtown Market (single start/end removed because hours differ by day; hours in time_text).
- Dates: St. Pete Pier Pumpkin Patch opens Thu Oct 8 (soft opening), not Oct 9; Keel Farms Harvest Days now follows the farm's own page ("Every Saturday & Sunday in October"), which adds Sat Oct 3.
